description: Internet Access, U.S. Counties is a dataset listed in Fulton County open data portal (sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Fulton County. This dataset contains the number and percentage of households with various types of internet access for U.S. counties with a population of at least 65,000. Coverage: Fulton County, Georgia. Its tags are spmo. The table has 29 columns. The portal shows 2022-09-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-sharefulton-fultoncountyga-gov-portal.
